verdict.rationale: Docs clearly describe reusable segments as 'collection of strategy constraints' that can be defined once and reused across flags, plus custom activation strategies/targeting rules and attribute-based constraints for controlling which users see which variation. A community comment (HN) suggests Unleash's rule system was seen as more limited than a competitor's at some point, tempering confidence slightly. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of rule complexity/expressiveness and more detail on constraint operators beyond brief mentions.
